summary.text: Rick Holdcroft is a member of the Nebraska Legislature who has represented District 36 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a retired Navy officer and former aerospace executive.

paragraphs.text: Holdcroft was born in San Diego, California, and graduated from Key West High School in 1972.
He earned a B.S. in electrical engineering from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln in 1976 and a graduate degree from the Naval Postgraduate School in 1982.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1976 to 2005 as a surface warfare officer, and his career experience includes working as an aerospace executive.
Ballotpedia lists volunteer service with the Knights of Columbus, the Bellevue Rotary Club, the Nebraska Navy League and the Air Force Association.
Holdcroft lost the 2020 general election for Nebraska Legislature District 3, according to Ballotpedia's campaign finance table, and won District 36 in 2022.
He assumed office on January 4, 2023, and Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the General Affairs Committee and a member of the Agriculture and Judiciary committees for 2025-2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired naval officer with 28 years of service, a father of five, a grandfather of eleven and a beekeeper.

He listed his campaign messages as reducing taxes, supporting education and opposing abortion while supporting women through pregnancy, and said he is passionate about criminal justice, agriculture and law enforcement.
